name: get_353552_followup
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json,subprocess,sys,os
LANE=os.getcwd()
plan={"url":"https://arxiv.org/pdf/2207.04831","routes":["353552"],"destination":"sources/2207.04831.pdf","source_identity":"Kaul et al, Bounding the List Color Function Threshold from Above, arXiv 2207.04831","purpose":"Read actual upper bound theorem and method for K_{2,n} to test prior art and routine reduction for 353552"}
w=os.path.join(LANE,'write_lane.py')
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',w,'plans/get-353552-followup.json'],input=json.dumps(plan,indent=1),text=True,capture_output=True);print('w',r.returncode,r.stderr)
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',os.path.join(LANE,'source_get_guard.py'),'plans/get-353552-followup.json'],text=True,capture_output=True)
print('g',r.returncode);print(r.stdout[:800]);print(r.stderr[:800])
if r.returncode==0:
    t=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout','sources/2207.04831.pdf','-'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',os.path.join(LANE,'write_lane.py'),'sources/2207.04831.txt'],input=t.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True)
    print(len(t.stdout),w.returncode)
    print(t.stdout[:14000])
